home.hero.title: Start from a clean launch pipeline
home.hero.description: The new kernel depends only on official Mojang endpoints and cross-platform .NET. The interface uses vertical navigation, card sections and soft hierarchy, organized in the spirit of whiteboard apps without copying their layout or assets.
home.progress.title: Migration progress
home.next.title: Next steps
install.title: Choose a version to install
install.description: Only the official Mojang manifest and asset sources are used. Installation does not include PCL signing, telemetry or update logic.
install.loader.title: Install a mod loader
install.loader.description: Builds a loader version on top of an installed vanilla version. Fabric / Quilt / Legacy Fabric use their Meta APIs; Forge / NeoForge / OptiFine use official installers; LiteLoader is generated from its manifest. Forge / NeoForge / OptiFine require Java.
install.content.title: What gets installed
install.directory.title: Directory layout
install.directory.desc: Versions go under versions in the current game directory; libraries and assets go into libraries and assets.
install.directory.hint: After installation, pick the version on the Launch page.
install.loader.select: Select a vanilla version, loader and loader version
install.loader.javaRequired: Installing Forge / NeoForge / OptiFine requires Java. Set it in Settings or install a runtime first.
